question: What is the increasing amount of the average earnings per job between the years 2012 and 2017 for each geographic region in Massachusetts (indicated by "MA" at the end of GeoName)?
sql:
WITH earnings AS (
  SELECT 
    GeoName,
    Year,
    Earnings_per_job_avg
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.sdoh_bea_cainc30.fips`
  WHERE GeoName LIKE '%, MA'
    AND Year BETWEEN '2012-01-01' AND '2017-12-31'
)
SELECT 
  GeoName,
  MAX(CASE WHEN Year = '2012-01-01' THEN Earnings_per_job_avg END) AS earnings_2012,
  MAX(CASE WHEN Year = '2017-01-01' THEN Earnings_per_job_avg END) AS earnings_2017,
  MAX(CASE WHEN Year = '2017-01-01' THEN Earnings_per_job_avg END) - MAX(CASE WHEN Year = '2012-01-01' THEN Earnings_per_job_avg END) AS increase
FROM earnings
GROUP BY GeoName
ORDER BY increase ASC
